query:
SELECT p.name as plante, m.name as molecule, pm.percentage
FROM plant_molecules pm
JOIN plants p ON pm.plant_id = p.id
JOIN molecules m ON pm.molecule_id = m.id
WHERE p.name IN ('Gingembre', 'Sauge sclarée', 'Pin sylvestre', 'Tea tree', 'Cardamome')
ORDER BY p.name, pm.percentage DESC;
